overall: Type 3 reviewed in depth; no confirmed valid-input defect found in reviewed obligations. One meaningful regression gap is drafted for a changed state-restoration line. CID and OpenType are partial, with explicit residuals.

features.source: EC3 PDF physical pp. 332–333 / printed pp. 317–318; doc/md/ISO_32000-2_sponsored_EC3.md:7766-7792. Table 110 requires FontMatrix, CharProcs, Encoding, FirstChar, LastChar, Widths; widths outside range are zero, Widths are glyph-space values and only horizontal transformed width advances; Resources is optional with fallback.
features.assessment: The tested mapping and horizontal advance behavior have independent geometry assertions and positive controls. Type3-specific no-default-glyph behavior is covered; AGL/fallback is outside this pass and was separately audited. No gap found in the inspected mapping requirements.

features.feature: CharProc execution environment, CTM, origin, graphics state, and resources
features.source: EC3 PDF physical p. 334 / printed p. 319; md:7798-7804. Steps b-c specify absent CharProcs means no glyph and graphics-state save/restore; execution CTM concatenates FontMatrix and text space, glyph coordinates are absolute with origin (0,0); inherited graphics state otherwise applies. Errata #128 amends resource lookup to glyph-stream, font, then page/inherited page resources.
features.implementation: crates/pdf-model/src/content/text/type3.rs:77-142; crates/pdf-model/src/type3.rs resource selection; crates/pdf-model/src/content.rs nested interpreter state.
features.assessment: The source rule and major execution behavior are asserted with discriminating fixtures. Current changed code explicitly saves/restores shape_only_glyph, but no existing assertion was found proving normal page transparency operations work after a d1 glyph returns; draft in drafts/type3_shape_state_restoration.rs.

features.source: EC3 PDF physical p. 335 / printed p. 320; md:7816-7822. d0 sets wx/wy (wy zero), must be first, width consistent with Widths and declares own color; d1 declares shape-only with glyph bbox, must be first; color operators are ignored and processing continues; image disallowed but image mask accepted. The producer's bbox accuracy and width consistency are not promoted to reader rejection rules.
assertions: pdf-archive/src/table/fonts.rs Type3 width consistency checks (producer conformance only)
features.assessment: The d1/d0 contrasting alpha/color tests are source-derived; validator width checks are not ordinary-reader behavior. No finding that malformed d0/d1 producer values must be rejected. The state restoration boundary is the only identified unasserted changed behavior.

features.feature: Glyph resources, nested content and recursion
features.source: EC3 PDF physical pp. 332-335 / printed pp. 317-320; §9.6.4 steps and EC3 #111, #128. #111 says operators from any category subject to restrictions and result for direct/indirect recursion is implementation-dependent; #128 changes resource search.
features.assessment: Resource precedence is directly discriminated. Recursion refusal is a reader policy permitted by EC3's implementation-dependent result, not a mandatory normative failure mode.

features.source: EC3 PDF physical pp. 355-356 / printed pp. 340-341; doc/md Table 119 around 8295 onward. Required Type, Subtype Type0, BaseFont, Encoding, one descendant; optional ToUnicode.
features.implementation: Ledger doc/conformance/ledger.toml:2611 onward maps composite font loading; this pass did not independently trace all parser branches or current assertions for every Table 119 entry.
assertions: Composite font tests are mapped by the ledger; individual bodies were not exhaustively inspected in this bounded audit.
features.assessment: Partial. No certification of Table 119 handling. BaseFont's arbitrary name is not itself interpreted as a font program.

features.feature: OpenType FontFile3 selection and required table families
features.source: EC3 PDF physical pp. 366-368 / printed pp. 351-353; doc/md §9.9 Table 124/125 around 8500 onward. OpenType is selected according to font dictionary and contained CFF/glyf table: Type1 CFF follows §9.6.5.2; TrueType/glyf and CID/CFF variants have different requirements. Table 125 extents apply to Type1/TrueType; CFF has no Length1-3.
features.implementation: Changed crates/pdf-font/src/loading.rs:1048-1150 substitutes a metrics-derived face for selected unreadable embedded programs; OpenType type selection in crates/pdf-font/src/loading/opening.rs (current change ADR 2817).
assertions: tests/opentype_selection_audit.rs has selection fixtures and distinct CFF/glyf assertions; unreadable_program_substitute.rs is relevant to new unreadable-program fallback.
features.assessment: Partial. This audit checked the current changed-code premise and selected ADR 2817 only; no complete validation of OpenType conformance, all Table 124 combinations, or unreadable-program substitute behavior.

not_claimed: Conformance of font programs to ISO/IEC 14496-22
Cryptographic or exhaustive fuzz validation of font readers
Mandatory rejection of producer-only d0/d1 width/bbox inconsistencies
